title: BAKER/POWDER VALLEY BASEBALL: Bulldogs fall 1-0 to Grant Union - NewsBreak
text:
By Jayson Jaco ,
1 days ago 1/3 Baker's Jake McClaughry leads off first base against Grant Union on April 7, 2026, at the Sports Complex. (Jayson Jacoby/Baker City Herald) In a classic pitchers’ duel at the Baker Sports Complex, Grant Union’s Kingdon Kirby had one last strikeout in his right arm, and it was enough.
Kirby, who gave up only one hit to Baker/Powder Valley, gave up two walks in the bottom of the seventh but he also had two strikeouts, including one for the final out in a 1-0 win on Tuesday, April 6.
On a warm afternoon with the wind blowing out to left field, Kirby and two Baker pitchers, starter Tucker Reid and reliever Will O’Connell, didn’t give up any long fly balls that might have gotten a boost from the breeze to clear the fence.
Reid and O’Connell combined on a one-hitter to match Kirby.
The Prospectors scored the game’s lone run in the top of the second, and appropriately, given the lack of offense, the run scored on Chet Workman’s ground ball out to Andy Richards at second base.
Also appropriately, Kirby was the only player to cross the plate.
He opened the inning by drawing a walk, then advanced to third when a pickoff throw rolled to the fence.
Baker’s Jake McClaughry had the Bulldogs’ only hit, a sharp single to center, to lead off the bottom of the second.
Richards’ sacrifice bunt with one out advanced McClaughry to second, but the Bulldogs couldn’t get a key hit.
Baker threatened in the bottom of the sixth. Nolan Briels walked with one out, and in a repeat of the second inning scenario, he made it to third on an errant pickoff attempt.
But again the Bulldogs couldn’t take advantage.
Reid and O’Connell, who pitched the final four innings, kept the Prospectors at bay with help from the Bulldog defense.
Third baseman Clay Stevens handled a few hard ground balls, and McClaughry in center, Colton Luschen in right field and Logan Crawford in left made difficult catches to deny Grant Union potential runs.
Baker, which played its home opener Tuesday, returns to the road this weekend. The Bulldogs play at Molalla Friday, April 10, at 5 p.m., and the next day at Gladstone at 12:30 p.m.
